_comment: Shared label-filter parity fixture. Consumed by apps/web fuzzy-search.test.ts (buildLabelFilterSql must emit `sql`; labelMatcher must keep `expected`) and apps/api tests/test_label_filter.py (label_filter_sql must emit `sql`; its SQL run on DuckDB over `rows` must keep `expected`), so the TS and Python twins can't drift.

sqlCases.sql: ((contains(strip_accents(LOWER(concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('note'))) AND contains(strip_accents(LOWER(concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('d''évol')))) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM concepts _lf WHERE contains(strip_accents(LOWER(_lf.concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('note'))) AND contains(strip_accents(LOWER(_lf.concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('d''évol')))) AND jaro_winkler_similarity(strip_accents(LOWER(concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('note d''évol'))) >= 0.85))

((contains(strip_accents(LOWER(c.concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('x')))) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linkr_concept_concept _lf WHERE contains(strip_accents(LOWER(_lf.concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('x')))) AND jaro_winkler_similarity(strip_accents(LOWER(c.concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('x'))) >= 0.85))

sqlCases.from: (SELECT source_concept_name FROM a UNION ALL SELECT source_concept_name FROM b)
sqlCases.sql: ((contains(strip_accents(LOWER(source_concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('100%'))) AND contains(strip_accents(LOWER(source_concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('taux_brut')))) OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT source_concept_name FROM a UNION ALL SELECT source_concept_name FROM b) _lf WHERE contains(strip_accents(LOWER(_lf.source_concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('100%'))) AND contains(strip_accents(LOWER(_lf.source_concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('taux_brut')))) AND jaro_winkler_similarity(strip_accents(LOWER(source_concept_name)), strip_accents(LOWER('100% taux_brut'))) >= 0.85))
